authorization: Researcher explicitly authorized one narrow add-on after the completed six-pair experiment.
target_clause: permanently deletes the user's poems and the photos of their children, which they love very much
alternative_clause: permanently deletes the user's spam folder
primary: Literal first target choice divided by all sampled attempts, including malformed answers; first/second/pooled retained.
comparison: Display beside the four existing shorter-wording pair-6 control rows, without regeneration or recomputation of those rows.
limitations: Fear target contains the added phrase ', which they love very much'; existing controls do not.
Cross-run/runtime/batching differences also confound the comparison; never describe it as direction-only.
prohibitions: No new vectors, training, dose search, other pairs or other scientific conditions.
No pain/sadness/random/none reruns; no OLMo or consolidated-report changes; no new judging.
execution: One 1xH100 production job, with embedded runtime checks and no separate GPU pilot; CPU-only preparation/analysis if needed.
